# Hex Dice

> Free tactical hexagon board game where each die is a soldier. Face value (1-6) sets unit type: Fencer, Archer, Hussar, Knight, Tanker, Oracle. 2-6 players, vs AI or online, plus a story campaign.

- [Play](https://hexdice.newsrss.org/): browser game
- [Daily Puzzle](https://hexdice.newsrss.org/?puzzle=daily): one shared "win in N turns" tactics puzzle per UTC day, with a shareable result
- [Rules](https://hexdice.newsrss.org/rules): units, combat, terrain, setup, win conditions
- [Rules (Markdown)](https://hexdice.newsrss.org/rules/RULES.md): authoritative rulebook
- [Printable board](https://hexdice.newsrss.org/assets/board.png): transparent board for physical play
- [Source](https://github.com/royalgarter/hexdice)
